notes.title: Go around the world without a VR headset!
notes.content:
The update adds the ability to select a Non-VR version of the game, which does not require a VR headset.
We have listened to multiple requests to make a non-VR version of the game.
Now all you need is a keyboard and a mouse to take part in the war with Sweden, arrange a natural exchange with the natives of Nuku Hiva, secretly explore the coast of Japan and establish trade relations with China.

More than three years on the journey - write yourself into the history of the Russian fleet. You can become a participant in the most important historical event, scrupulously restored from the diaries of the main characters and hundreds of historical documents, without wearing virtual reality headset.
